digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate (orchestrator, criteria routing, review kernel integration)
propositions: Seven plan-review recommendations (R1-R7) from task-decomposition SOTA report must be implemented with eval-based validation gating, where each recommendation either passes its experiment gate or is deferred with results recorded

Original batch-eval-gated strategy was replaced by operator-approved advisory-first + standing-dogfood approach: R1/R3/R4 ship as advisory (never blocking), pass bounded sanity checks, and are monitored via d8a5 standing effectiveness recorder for later advisory→blocking promotion

E1 outcome corpus (628 rows, event-mined) was frozen and committed; E1's finding-adjudication/inter-rater-κ corpus was descoped as invalid (tool-less, plan-truncated labeling ~79% contaminated); E2/E3 expensive LLM batch baselines were permanently rejected on cost and superseded by d8a5

All R1-R7 recommendations landed through Gerrit with children closed: R6 shipped deterministic without eval gate; R2 lands via det_floor.py static checks; R1/R3/R4 land as advisory; R5 requires E5 non-regression gate and IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION coordination

Blocking-FP promotion gate documented: a criterion demotes to advisory when its trailing blocking-FP proxy exceeds 10% over a measurement window, validated by R7 instrumentation against E1's committed outcome corpus

Plan-review methodology updated in docs/plan-review-gate.md; all validated changes incorporated directly into packaged review process (no config-flag overlays); no A/B testing, validation is eval-based with post-ship observation via R7 dogfooding
